_about: Hand-verified building facts used by finder.py (style, year built, stories, reviews). Checked 2026-10-31. 'style' == 'garden' is rejected; year_built < --min-year is rejected unless fully_renovated. Optional 'reject' text excludes a property for a reason verified by hand (e.g. aggregator shows a 15-month-lease price).

Passport Apartments Herndon.reviews: RentCafe 4.5 (22); Birdeye 3.8 (132); Yelp 2.8 (6). Complaints: fire alarms, elevator outages, leaks in heavy rain, visitor parking.
Passport Apartments Herndon.fees: Trash $35/mo; amenity fee $400/yr; admin $250 one-time; parking $25-75/mo optional.

The Ian.fees: Trash $18 + utility admin $6.06 + HOA $4.50 + pest $1.50 = ~$30/mo; water/sewer submetered; amenity $400 one-time.
The Ian.notes: Greystar quotes total monthly price; rent.com figure ($2,161) differed from official calculator (unit 490: $2,136 base / $2,166 total, 12-mo). Elevator and in-unit W/D not confirmed.

Station on Silver.reviews: Apartments.com 2.2 (16); Yelp 2.3 (16); Birdeye 3.0 (174). Complaints: broken gate/security, package theft, elevator outages, roaches, towing, management.
Station on Silver.fees: Valet trash $40 + required garage parking $65 + required cable/internet $120 = ~$225/mo; water/sewer (~$42) and electric extra.
Station on Silver.notes: A1O 'now' units are only cheap on 13-15 month leases (12-mo ~$2,640+). WDU plans (A1O-WDU, A1P-WDU) are income-restricted (80%/100% AMI).

Camden Dulles Station.reviews: Birdeye 4.1 (138); Yelp ~4.0 (61); ApartmentRatings 3.8 (141). Complaints: fees, staff, tight garage.
Camden Dulles Station.fees: Tech package $128 + trash $32.50 + garage $25 = $185.50/mo required; admin $400 + community $100 one-time.
Camden Dulles Station.notes: Camden's listed prices are 15-month-lease prices; 12-month is ~$250-290 higher.

Makers Rise.reviews: ApartmentRatings 4.5 (577); Birdeye 3.8 (130). Complaints: limited internet providers, noise.
Makers Rise.notes: Official site blocked automated checks - prices unverified. 'W' plans (B00.1W, B01W, B10W) are WDU income-restricted.

ICON at Dulles.reviews: ApartmentRatings 4.2 (364); Apartments.com 4.1 (8). Complaints: broken doors, dog waste, parking.
ICON at Dulles.fees: Not published officially; third-party: amenity $350 move-in, valet trash $35/mo, building protection $10/mo.
ICON at Dulles.notes: Only sub-$2,180 1BR is #2343-332 at $2,176 (avail 11/7); specials: $1,000/$500 off, ask about 1 month free.

The Point at Ridgeline.reviews: ApartmentRatings 4.7; Yelp 3.9 (13). Complaints: thin walls/noise, sirens, balcony flooding, garage door, visitor parking fee.
The Point at Ridgeline.fees: Trash $15/mo; utility admin $4.51/mo; water/sewer billed with rent; amenity $500 one-time; garage parking $75.
The Point at Ridgeline.notes: Plans marked (WDU) are Fairfax County Workforce Dwelling Units (80/100/120% AMI).

The Point at Monroe Place.reviews: ApartmentRatings 4.7; Birdeye 3.8 (101); Yelp 4.0 (9). Complaints: fee increases, compact washer/dryer, pool heating, small gym.
The Point at Monroe Place.fees: Valet trash ~$35/mo; utility admin ~$4.50/mo; water/sewer billed with rent; amenity $500 move-in + $300/yr renewal; parking $45-60.

Ashton at Dulles Corner.reviews: Google 3.7 (721, shown on Bozzuto page); ApartmentRatings 3.8 (297); Apartments.com 4.2 (135); Yelp 2.4 (61). Complaints: slow maintenance, water outages, fire alarms, thin walls.
Ashton at Dulles Corner.fees: Fixed $44.05/mo (valet trash, trash, stormwater, admin, pest) + usage water/sewer/gas; amenity $250/lease.
Ashton at Dulles Corner.notes: rent.com shows total price incl. $44.05 fixed fees; official base rent is ~$45 lower.

Skymark.reviews: ApartmentRatings 4.6 (4); Apartments.com 1 review (1 star). Complaints: slow management, long elevator waits.
Skymark.notes: All sub-$2,180 1BRs are WDU (income-restricted, $1,995 base). Cheapest market-rate 1BR $2,240.

Faraday Park.reviews: Google 4.5 (225); Apartments.com/ForRent 4.8 (256). Complaints: low light, limited storage, garage vandalism, noise.
Faraday Park.notes: Only sub-$2,180 1BR is a junior (JR) plan whose bedroom appears windowless. Cheapest regular 1BR $2,373.

Camden Monument Place.notes: rent.com prices are 15-month-lease prices; 12-month quotes are ~$290-300 higher (none under $2,180).
Camden Monument Place.reject: official 12-month-lease 1BR quotes are all >= $2,269 (rent.com shows 15-month prices)
